page.overview:
Who is Fred and George Weasley?

Fred and George Weasley were mischievous twin wizards born on 1 April 1978 to Arthur Weasley and Molly Weasley (née Prewett). The two were both brilliant pranksters that co-founded and ran the joke shop Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes. They were members of both Dumbledore's Army and the Order of the Phoenix.
